scope.summary: Implement the `selection` command family over the single StudioSelectionSet (raster/vector/layout context-agnostic): set/add/subtract/intersect, select-by id/kind/name, currentPage selection, bulk-edit targeting. Deduped from all source selection APIs into ONE family. Dry-run/receipt/undo/promotion; selection changes emit STUDIO_SELECTION_CHANGED.
acceptance_criteria: selection family on one StudioSelectionSet; deduped; event-emitting; dry-run/undo
expected_tests: live: selection.select_by_kind returns selection set + emits STUDIO_SELECTION_CHANGED
test: one selection model across contexts

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

risk_if_missed: No selection automation, or a per-context selection silo re-introduced.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
